description: This file defines the interface and classes for inter-process communication (IPC) related to control functionalities within the Rialto client component. It includes factory and control classes, method declarations for shared memory access, client registration, and event handling, as well as references to external protobuf-generated classes.

classes.name: ControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ControlIpc, providing a method to obtain shared pointers to IControlIpc objects.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements the IControlIpc interface for IPC control operations, manages event subscriptions, and handles server events.

methods.name: ControlIpcFactory::getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlIpc instance associated with the provided control client.

methods.name: ControlIpcFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControlIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: ControlIpc::getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size from the server.

methods.name: ControlIpc::registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the server.

methods.name: ControlIpc::createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for communication with the server.

methods.name: ControlIpc::subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to server events such as application state updates and pings.

methods.name: ControlIpc::onApplicationStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles application state change events received from the server.

methods.name: ControlIpc::onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events received from the server.
